item.title: New recipe: Advent Calendar
item.description: By Solarmax · Six Christmas countdown themes
item.content:encoded:
Advent Calendar : Six Christmas countdown themes

By Solarmax · calendar, life

From the author (About This Plugin)

Make a little room for Christmas with a three-day paper calendar. <br><br>Choose from six themes: <br>• Bible readings — daily passages in WEB or BSB. <br>• Holiday movies — a movie pick and an original movie-night prompt. <br>• Christmas mystery — a family-friendly clue each day, with the answer on Christmas. <br>• Acts of Kindness — a practical, thoughtful way to help someone each day. <br>• Daily Self-Affirmations — gentle reminders for holiday calm, self-compassion, and joy without excess. <br>• Christmas Around the World trivia — a sourced question and answer about a festive tradition each day. <br><br>The five December themes begin December 1; Bible readings begin on the first Sunday of Advent. Future mystery clues stay sealed until their date. All four layouts and daily content are included. Dates follow your TRMNL account time zone. QR codes open Bible passages or the day's movie on Rotten Tomatoes. The other themes have no QR codes. <br><br>Missed a day? Visit <a href="https://geolizard.com/advent/">Geolizard.com/advent</a> for today's entry and earlier items, updated daily after each theme's countdown starts. All entries remain available through December 31; the website resets for the next year on January 1.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

item.title: New recipe: Trade Plan Board
item.description: By Creator #45264 · Trade plans grid, pushed by webhook
item.content:encoded:
Trade Plan Board : Trade plans grid, pushed by webhook

By Creator #45264 · finance, kpi

From the author (About This Plugin)

Trade Plan Board shows a clean grid of trading plans on your TRMNL: ticker, status, reference price, entry, stop, targets with optional R multiples, and a short invalidation line.<br><br>The full screen holds up to six plans in a 3-by-2 grid, or 2-by-3 in portrait. Half horizontal shows 2 plans on TRMNL OG and 3 on TRMNL X. Half vertical shows up to 2 stacked. Quadrant shows a single plan. The title bar reads Trade Plans. The preview on this page uses invented demo tickers and round numbers only, never live positions.<br><br><strong>This is a webhook recipe.</strong> After you install it, copy your unique URL from the <strong>Webhook URL</strong> field on this plugin's settings page (a click-to-copy field) and POST JSON to it. Put every field inside a merge_variables object. A push replaces the stored data. Each installer pushes their own data; the author's feed is never shared. Leave "Share pushed data with installs" off.<br><br>Using Grok Bot? Ask it for a routine that POSTs your data to the Webhook URL above on a schedule — no code needed.<br><br><strong>Payload schema.</strong> Top-level keys:<br>• <code>plans</code> (required) — an array of plan objects. The full layout shows the first 6; mashup sizes show fewer.<br>• <code>grid_cols</code> and <code>grid_rows</code> (optional) — kept for compatibility. The markup chooses columns from the layout and orientation.<br>• <code>empty_slots</code> (optional) — extra empty cells on the full layout only, for a fixed 3-by-2 when you have fewer than 6 plans.<br>• <code>note</code> (optional) — title-bar instance text, for example Demo data.<br><br>Each item in <code>plans</code>:<br>• <code>ticker</code> — short symbol, for example ACME<br>• <code>status_short</code> — short status, for example WAIT, ARMED, or OPEN<br>• <code>ref_price</code> — shown with a $ prefix<br>• <code>flag</code> — optional extra label; omit or leave blank to hide it<br>• <code>entry_zone</code> and <code>stop</code> — shown with a $ prefix<br>•

item.title: New recipe: Minute by Minute
item.description: Created by community member excuseme. Enable and now you can truthfully say you read a good book lately.
item.content:encoded:
Minute by Minute : A book passage for every minute

By excuseme · life

Created by community member excuseme. Enable and now you can truthfully say you read a good book lately.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

<strong>A stylized literary clock.</strong> For every minute, it shows a passage from a book that names that very minute, set as a typographic poster: the words that tell the time large and black, the story around them sized so every line runs edge to edge, the book and its author in the title bar.<br /><br />A passage for each of the 1440 minutes of the day, nearly all with a real time phrase ("twenty minutes past seven"), and where possible one that fits the half of the day, so evenings get evening scenes. The quotes come from public-domain books on <a href='https://www.gutenberg.org' target='_blank'>Project Gutenberg</a> and the literature-clock collections of <a href='https://github.com/JohsEnevoldsen/literature-clock' target='_blank'>JohsEnevoldsen</a> (CC BY-NC-SA 2.5), <a href='https://github.com/cdmoro/literature-clock' target='_blank'>cdmoro</a> and <a href='https://github.com/utrost/LiteratureClock' target='_blank'>utrost</a> (AGPL-3.0).<br /><br />Made by <a href='https://github.com/ExcuseMi' target='_blank'>ExcuseMi</a>.

item.content:encoded:
Kurashi : Everyday objects of Showa Japan

By ewijaya · life, art

Created by community member ewijaya. Enable and enjoy life's simplest things.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

<p>A rotary phone rings. A radio murmurs by the window. Steam rises from a freshly opened rice cooker. Kurashi brings the small rituals of Showa Japan to your TRMNL, one illustrated object at a time.</p><p>Kurashi means everyday life. This collection pairs sixty original ink illustrations with short Japanese stories and separately sourced historical notes. Its printed-book layout gives each object room to breathe.</p><p><strong>The cards are in Japanese; setup is in English. Optional furigana and a short English gloss are available in settings.</strong> Choose a new object each day, a new object at each refresh, or keep a favorite on display. Seasonal modes follow your TRMNL time zone. Full-screen and all three mashup layouts are included, with shorter selections on smaller screens.</p><p>No extra account, API key, or additional service setup is needed. Artwork and fonts are hosted for you. Historical references accompany the full-screen cards; the illustrations and stories are period-inspired interpretations.</p>

item.description: By Creator #38420 · Home value from Zillow ZIP data
item.content:encoded:
Home Value Estimate : Home value from Zillow ZIP data

By Creator #38420 · finance, personal

From the author (About This Plugin)

Estimates your home's value from what you paid and how typical home values in your ZIP code have changed since, using the <a href="https://www.zillow.com/research/data/" class="underline">Zillow Home Value Index</a> (updated monthly).<br/><br/>
Enter your ZIP code, and optionally your purchase price and the month you bought. The plugin shows today's estimated value, your gain in dollars and percent, the typical home value in your ZIP, and how much values there have changed over the last 12 months. Leave the purchase fields blank to show the typical home value for any ZIP code. You can also show your street address or a nickname as the heading; it stays in your plugin settings and is never sent to the data server.<br/><br/>
There is no sign-up or API key. The estimate follows typical homes in your ZIP, not your specific house, so it is not a Zestimate or an appraisal. Data: Zillow Research. Questions and issues are welcome on <a href="https://github.com/mgeilich/trmnl-home-value" class="underline">GitHub</a>.

Hotspots: Volcanic Activity Map : See where the Earth runs hot

By IsarWorks · nature, education

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and ease off the pressure, else you might explode.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Ever wonder which volcanoes are running hot right now? Hotspots gives you a global view.<br><br> Hotspots turns NASA satellite observations of thermal activity into a minimalist map of the world's volcanoes.<br><br> Each known volcano gets its own little marker, sized according to the relative thermal activity detected by satellites.<br><br>Hotspots also checks the Smithsonian's Global Volcanism Program for reported ongoing eruptions. Volcanoes listed as erupting get a little ash plume, so you can tell them apart from volcanoes showing a heat signal alone.<br><br>As observations age, the markers fade, so you can see where activity has been spotted recently without drowning in data.<br><br>Install (don''t Fork!) to receive future updates. <br><br>v1.1 2026-11-12 Fine tuned volcano icon and label ledgibility.

<p>Bring the dry office humor of the German TV series Stromberg to your TRMNL. This plugin displays random German-language quotes with the character's name, turning a spare corner of your dashboard into a regular dose of workplace satire. The quotes remain in their original German.</p>
<p>The layout supports all four TRMNL sizes: full screen, horizontal half, vertical half and quadrant. It adapts to TRMNL OG and TRMNL X in landscape and portrait orientation. <p>An independent fan-made plugin, with quotes supplied by the <a href="https://stromberg-api.de/" class="underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Stromberg API</a>.</p>

item.title: New recipe: Abyss
item.description: Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and don't hold your breath.
item.content:encoded:
Abyss : A window into the deep ocean

By IsarWorks · discovery, education

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and don't hold your breath.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

<strong>A window into the abyss.</strong><br>
Turn your TRMNL into your personal window into the deep ocean. Abyss lets you peek into a fascinating corner of our planet: the deep Pacific. Explore hydrothermal vents on Axial Seamount, a methane seep at Southern Hydrate Ridge, and the Oregon Offshore seafloor. These are real research camera images from places most of us will never visit.<br><br>

<strong>Choose your view</strong><br>
Cycle through all four cameras, choose a few favourites, or settle into one. Leave the camera selection empty to rotate through every published camera.<br><br>
The default 15-minute refresh rotates your selected views. Images are processed every three hours from periodic recordings and snapshots. When a camera cannot update, its last good image stays on display.<br><br>

<strong>Where are the cameras?</strong><br>
Four camera views across three research sites in the northeast Pacific. Both vent cameras are on Axial Seamount; the other cameras look across Southern Hydrate Ridge and the Oregon Offshore seafloor. All depths are approximate.<br><br>

<strong>ASHES: Mushroom vent — about 1,540 m</strong><br>
On Axial Seamount, an active underwater volcano on the Juan de Fuca Ridge. This camera looks into the ASHES hydrothermal vent field, where hot fluids emerge from the volcanic seafloor.<br>
<a href="https://interactiveoceans.washington.edu/research-sites/axial-caldera/ashes/">Explore the research site</a> · <a href="https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/media.ooica.net/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/06193730/ASHES-Map-2020.png">Detailed site map</a><br><br>

<strong>International District: Tiny Towers — about 1,520 m</strong><br>
A second hydrothermal vent field on Axial Seamount. The Tiny Towers camera offers another view of the volcano's deep-sea habitat.<br>
<a href="https://interactiveoceans.washington.edu/research-sites/axial-caldera/international-district/">Explore the research site</a> · <a href="https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws

This or That is a shared weekly vote for TRMNL. Scan either QR code, sign in with your TRMNL account, and confirm your choice. Each account gets one final vote per round. Watch the bar move as the votes come in, with last week's results below. <br><br>No API keys or setup are required. Everyone sees the same matchup and community score. A new round starts every Monday at midnight Central Time (America/Chicago). Scores update with your device's normal refresh, and completed rounds are saved in the game's history. Supports TRMNL OG and X in all four layouts. <br><br>Created by Mark Hopper. Check out his other projects on GitHub, or use the email link below for support.

Coming Up displays your next calendar events, however far ahead they are. Combine up to five ICS calendars into one chronological agenda, with a maximum of 15 events.
